steps.title: 2021: Europe was Russia's main oil customer
text: In 2021 [Russia](RUS) exported about **$115 billion** of crude oil. The [European Union](EU) bought **46%** of it, [China](CHN) 31%, and [India](IND) barely 1%.
The map shows the value of Russia's crude oil exports to each partner. These figures come from CEPII BACI, which reconciles what exporters and importers report.

steps.title: 2022: war and sanctions
text: [Russia](RUS) invaded Ukraine in early 2022. The [EU](EU) banned imports of Russian crude oil by sea from **5 December 2022**; oil delivered by pipeline was exempted, and the G7, EU and [Australia](AUS) set a price cap of $60 a barrel.
With oil prices high, Russia's crude exports actually rose to about **$148 billion** in 2022. The EU still took 38%, and [India](IND)'s share had already jumped to 17%.

steps.title: 2023–24: the oil flows east
text: Once the embargo took effect, the [EU](EU)'s share of [Russia](RUS)'s crude exports collapsed to **5%** by 2024 (about $7 billion).
[China](CHN) (**50%**, $63 billion) and [India](IND) (**42%**, $53 billion) now take almost all of it. Watch the arcs swing from Europe to Asia.

ask.q: By 2024, who bought the most Russian crude oil?

steps.title: India's new top supplier
text: Seen from [India](IND), [Russia](RUS) went from supplying **1%** of its crude oil imports in 2021 to **37%** in 2024, overtaking [Iraq](IRQ) and [Saudi Arabia](SAU).
The panel compares India's crude imports from Russia over time.
